## Lesson quality checklist

- [ ] R1 — Beginner-first: define new terms in plain language.
- [ ] R2 — Exact commands or explicit UI instructions for each action.
- [ ] R3 — Complete files with paths; never leave code fragments to infer.
- [ ] R4 — Expected output follows commands; variable output is identified.
- [ ] R5 — Each step explains the action, reason, and checkpoint.
- [ ] R6 — Windows and macOS/Linux variants are provided where commands differ.
- [ ] R7 — Tested tool versions and actual outputs are recorded.
- [ ] R8 — At least three common errors have exact messages and fixes.
- [ ] R9 — Steps stay small and long files are explained progressively.
- [ ] R10 — A reader can learn without running the code.
- [ ] R11 — Every source acceptance criterion maps to lesson evidence.
- [ ] R12 — Friendly, direct second-person language; no emoji in code or commands.
